description: Source code for embedded system tasks and hooks related to the Os module, including task definitions, event handling, and error logging for an HCS12 MCU platform.

methods.name: IncommingFreqReq
methods.description: Callback function triggered when a frequency request PDU arrives on COM, sets an event for the communication receive task.

methods.name: DipTask
methods.description: Reads dip switch port, updates LED bar port, reads ADC group to set PWM duty cycle for green LED.

methods.name: StartTask
methods.description: Performs startup procedures including ECU management, starting communication groups, setting controller mode, and starting ADC conversion.

methods.name: ComTask
methods.description: Handles reception and transmission of communication stack.

methods.name: ComReceiveTask
methods.description: Waits for frequency request event, processes the request, adjusts alarm, and sends response signal.

methods.name: ErrorHook
methods.description: Logs error details into a buffer for later review, with a stall if buffer is full.

methods.name: PostTaskHook
methods.description: Logs pre-task hook event with task ID.

methods.name: PreTaskHook
methods.description: Logs pre-task hook event with task ID.

methods.name: ShutdownHook
methods.description: Handles shutdown event, enters infinite loop.

methods.name: StartupHook
methods.description: Handles startup event, logs startup message.
